# v4.4.2c: browser-side hit SFX from the approved user WAV, encoded as MP3 data URI.
# This keeps the SFX self-contained in the GitHub Pages build and avoids external hotlink failures.
if window is not None:
    try:
        window.eval(r"""
(() => {
  if (window.playLancerHitSfx) return;
  const SRC='data:audio/mpeg;base64,';
  const pool=Array.from({length:4},()=>{const a=new Audio(SRC);a.preload='auto';a.volume=1;return a;});
  let cursor=0, primed=false;
  const prime=()=>{
    if(primed)return; primed=true;
    for(const a of pool){
      const v=a.volume;a.volume=0;
      const p=a.play();
      if(p&&p.then)p.then(()=>{a.pause();a.currentTime=0;a.volume=v;}).catch(()=>{a.volume=v;});
      else {a.pause();a.currentTime=0;a.volume=v;}
    }
  };
  document.addEventListener('pointerdown',prime,{once:true,capture:true});
  document.addEventListener('keydown',prime,{once:true,capture:true});
  window.playLancerHitSfx=()=>{
    if(window.lancerInput?.muted)return;
    const a=pool[cursor++%pool.length];
    try{a.pause();a.currentTime=0;}catch{}
    const p=a.play(); if(p&&p.catch)p.catch(()=>{});
  };
})();
""")
    except Exception:
        pass
